verdict.rationale: Base44's quick-start docs say you can 'Turn a Figma frame into a working app' and 'Begin from a website you already own'. The AI chat-modes docs add that sharing a public website link copies its design, layout, and visible content into the app. Together these cover importing both a Figma design and an existing design for the builder to implement. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Figma import flow (how files or frames are connected, fidelity, and handling of multi-frame files), and independent or hands-on confirmation that imported designs are implemented accurately.
